route_title: Constrained Layers 4-6 Refinement with Anchored Search
compilation_rationale: Compiled a 17-layer planar stack on Al with air incidence. Initialized from provided round-1 thicknesses and applied specified bounds to indices 4 and 6. Optimized all 17 layer thicknesses in [50, 300] nm using Adam-LBFGS with reduced learning rate. Added four unweighted objectives to maximize absorption and reflectance in [400, 700] nm and [700, 2000] nm respectively, suppressing unwanted cross-band responses. All physics fields conform to layered isotropic plane-wave model with coherent propagation.
